findings.title: Generic API misclassifies messaging identities as config machine IDs
findings.observed: Both independent reviewers reproduced ordinary thread label POST failure with real SQLite. JsonApiController identifies a non-default identity key without a bundle as config-style and generates a string identity from title/body/role. Messaging declares numeric content identities with UUID and no bundle. Label omission or a numeric diagnostic label succeeds in the same composition.
findings.expected_contract: Content entity storage identity must be allocated by its declared storage model; real config entities retain machine-name generation.
findings.consequence: Ordinary messaging labels fail at persistence before a usable generic API result. This defect is owned by API, with messaging as affected consumer.
findings.refutation: Numeric or absent labels succeed, isolating the API identity heuristic from provider/repository failure. Numeric client identities are a diagnostic control, not a consumer workaround.
findings.acceptance: Create thread, message and membership through generic API with normal labels and no client identity; prove durable numeric storage identities and correct UUID representation; preserve real config machine names and refusal of content identity injection.
findings.next_action: API owner reviews and files a bounded regression slice; do not add it to messaging repairs.

findings.title: Public adapter symbols require another class to be loaded first

findings.expected_contract: Retained public symbols independently autoload in the declared Composer profile.
findings.consequence: Direct consumers can fail before policy construction even though factory-produced adapters work.
findings.refutation: Factories load the containing policy, so ordinary discovery/factory paths remain reachable. This is a public autoloadability mismatch, not broken provider boot.
findings.acceptance: Express active Protected-read adapter contracts intentionally: independently autoload any public concrete symbols, or make implementation-only adapters internal with current factory consumers preserved. Alpha compatibility is not a retention reason. Preserve exact principal, subject and entity/field refusal semantics.
